corpus: EWCCE-DATA: English Writing Corpus Collection and Evaluation (version 1)
attribution: Aladdin, A., Khalid, R., Rashid, S., & Ahmed, A. (2026). EWCCE-DATA: English Writing Corpus Collection and Evaluation (Version 1). Mendeley Data.
findings: The archive holds 200 single-page PDF scans (Orignal/Paragraph writing 1-223-pages-N.pdf) and nothing else: no file with the two raters' criterion scores, although the dataset description says they are included.
The task is a paragraph of 100-150 words on everyday topics (technology, social media), not an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay; the scans checked contain no rater marks.
Without the scores the set gives no reference; with them it would still measure single paragraphs, where the guide's paragraphing limiter caps CC by rule.
next: Use only if the authors publish the score sheet; then decide whether paragraph-length scripts are worth the transcription (about $2). Until then Phase 1 has no human IELTS-band reference (E §2 H2).
